minor_issues: At 390px, the header timestamp wraps after the year, making it slightly harder to scan.
At 390px, the third review-status legend item wraps onto its own line, making the legend slightly uneven.
strengths: The desktop layout establishes a clear hierarchy from summary metrics to the review queue and selected spec.
The selected row has a distinct outline and background, and status and risk indicators pair color with readable labels.
The mobile summary tiles, search field, and filter buttons fit the viewport, and the first spec title wraps without truncation.
The desktop detail panel aligns the metric cards, review actions, checklist, and timeline with consistent spacing.
summary: The three screenshots show a readable, well-aligned interface with sufficient contrast for the visible text and controls. No major defects or unintended clipping are visible. Mobile assessment is limited to the header, overview, filters, and top of the queue.
